prompt:
Draw ONE complete full-colour manga PAGE, portrait, read left to right, with exactly FOUR panels, black panel borders, thin white gutters and a small white page margin. Style: approachable Indian slice-of-life manga, clean confident line art with varied line weight, soft flat cel shading, warm natural light, simple readable backgrounds, expressive natural faces, precise hands. No photorealism, no glossy gradients, no surface microtexture. BALLOON SPACE: in EVERY panel keep the upper quarter as plain empty background (plain wall, ceiling or sky) with no faces, hands, screens or important objects in it; speech balloons and captions are added there later. Keep heads below that band. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT anywhere: no letters, words, numbers, speech balloons, captions, sound effects, signage text, logos, brand marks or watermarks. Do not draw any Welbuk logo, and no heart, cross or medical-cross symbols. Screens show only simple abstract interface shapes: a hot-pink (#FD006A) header bar, white cards, grey lines, simple icons and charts; never readable text or numbers. All data is fictional.

REFERENCE IMAGES: Image 1 = main-cast.png (character identity sheet; match faces, hair, build and clothing exactly; do not copy its layout or labels); Image 2 = nurse.png (character identity sheet; match faces, hair, build and clothing exactly; do not copy its layout or labels).

CAST ON THIS PAGE:
MEERA: Meera, Indian woman, late 20s, receptionist; long black single braid over her LEFT shoulder, blue block-print kurta, thin silver bangle on her right wrist; large round eyes, high thin brows, round face.
NURSE: the Nurse, Indian woman, early 30s; chin-length wavy black bob tucked behind her right ear, plain LAVENDER scrub top and trousers, lavender lanyard with a blank card, small watch on her left wrist.
ADMIN: the Clinic Administrator, Indian man, 40s; short hair, glasses, navy blazer over a white shirt.

PAGE LAYOUT: Panel 1 full-width at the top (about 35% of the page height); panels 2 and 3 side by side in the middle (about 30%); panel 4 full-width at the bottom (about 35%).

PANELS (left-to-right, top-to-bottom reading order):
Panel 1: Morning: Meera and the Nurse arrive at the clinic entrance for their shift.
Panel 2: The Nurse taps her phone on a small attendance terminal by the staff door.
Panel 3: The Clinic Administrator reviewing an abstract staff calendar and attendance grid on his laptop.
Panel 4: Wide: reception, nursing, a doctor and the administrator each working at their stations, each with a device.
